critical_code_review_comments: media_library.py: acoustic_profile excludes private fields via store.public() — verified by test. Good.
acoustic register exposes 55+ observables across the 6 required chains with consistent schema (chain/key/label/unit/method).
Worker is in-process thread — acceptable for current MVP; consider external worker/queue for production fan-out when audio library grows beyond ~hundreds of files.
Assessment endpoint requires non-empty file_ids (422 if missing) — correct validation.
